name: Halen Darkroot
source_profile: ● Halen Darkroot (LN) is the captain of the Hidden Wardens, who enforces the tribe's strict boundaries and has threatened to expel Saelis for revealing their paths.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 65 (source excerpt; may be partial)
